lede: Western Michigan carries the stronger underlying team rating — -2.8 against -10.3, a 7.5-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Buffalo +9.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Western Michigan winning 74% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offensive line, where Western Michigan leads Buffalo by 106 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
